original_test_intent: Drive the approved targeted-power workload and prove its subtests complete while GPU/platform draw, PSU/feed capacity, cooling and device health remain within approved limits.
original_method: Pin driver/DCGM and script; resolve source level 4 versus power level 7 plus workload/duration; baseline GPU/CPU/NVSwitch power limits and readings, PSU/feed redundancy/headroom, fans, ambient/temperatures and errors; drain workloads, preserve logs, verify OOB; run once with hard-stop telemetry, then cool down and verify service/device recovery.
manual_activity: Power/thermal owners approve targeted load, expected draw and all rail/PSU/temperature abort limits; operator verifies redundant feeds, cooling, OOB, workload drain and emergency stop.
required_inputs: GPU/platform/rail power limits and telemetry sources
Dedicated window, OOB, hard stops and recovery
safety_requirements: Continuously enforce power and thermal hard stops
No automatic retry after an excursion
agent_execution_scope: Confirm isolation, redundant power and OOB
Run one approved power test under monitoring
Cool down, restore state and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Choose level/load and approve power envelope

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Level 7 may be the targeted-power group but conflicts with source level 4 and omits source setup, script identity and the required power-path safeguards.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute the approved pinned power command once only after PSU/feed/cooling gates and hard-stop monitoring are verified.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Targeted-power intent, 120-minute allowance and every-subtest criterion remain; exact level requires decision.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate declared power target with GPU/platform/rail readings, PSU/feed/fan/thermal telemetry and independent hard stops through load and cooldown.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds scope choice, power-path capacity, time-series evidence and emergency recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Targeted stress or memory bandwidth cannot substitute for a power-specific workload and supply oracle.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sustained high draw can trip feeds/PSUs, overheat hardware, crash host/GPU or invalidate redundancy.

project_override_considerations: Power engineering must define expected draw/tolerance, rail/PSU/feed headroom, redundant-feed acceptance, fan/thermal thresholds and hard-stop authority.
expected_evidence: Selected-level rationale, pinned script hash and declared target/load/duration
Complete power-test output/exits and subtest results
XID/AER/BMC/service events and any stop record
Cooldown/final health/restored state and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Provides a measurable end-to-end power-delivery and cooling oracle instead of relying on an internal stress PASS alone.
independent_technical_reasoning: A targeted-power plugin may achieve load while a PSU loses redundancy, a rail exceeds its envelope or the platform throttles. PASS therefore requires time-aligned workload, power-path and thermal evidence plus recovery, not merely DCGM's aggregate status.
